folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B332: existing consumers and current direction
folds.body:
All 163 original lines were reviewed, including each COV01–COV11 row, MA01–MA13, world placements and proposed proof. The strongest preserved value is a concrete additional consumer for existing knowledge, a specific customer relationship, instance-bound treatment, truthful present usability and a real crossing consequence. No new generic guild, remembered-skill currency, world-affinity system or compulsory remort follows from the donors. Learning, source faculty, leased assistance, recognition, current tool and inherited property remain different owners.

The report's source-present claims and coverage-evidence hashes describe the inspected slice at its recorded revision. They were not re-established by this document read. A conventional doorway refusing borrowed goods can coexist with a more general evaluator accepting scoped permission; neither proves native arbitrary cargo/companion travel. The bounded heir transfer does not transfer every career, a predecessor's embodied competence or ownership of an independent worker. MA13 remains a useful estate extension, with actual surviving rights, recipients and unresolved work specified if selected.

Current AD51 favors the first useful shared seam, then a different world validates it; these thirteen proposals do not create a second queue or a requirement to build all of them. AD52 allows suitable routine/delegation without a universal manual-first unlock. An actual customer can fund an order through a real institution or representative as well as directly. Support loss ends the assistance it actually supplies, while retained learning stays unless a real mechanism changes it. World-lock or lease restrictions mentioned here are bounded implementation observations, not universal restrictions on future powerful means.

The 1366×768 target in MA04/A3 is historical. Later selected UI work uses the current desktop targets and readable text in the live UI owner; this review makes no rebuilt rendering claim. Frontier/Village placement remains a reference/testbed, not a new depth priority over the current LOTM-first and Harry developer routes. The A Soldier's Life row is a distinct title; its adjacent bare TTKS label is an ambiguous mirror-family shorthand, not another novel or a source contract. Any later use must name the actual title and source rather than assigning the five-title mirror a shared canon.

Preserve the whole proposal palette and source/history links. Actual implementation, native routes, current source compatibility and persistence remain to be established for a selected consumer. Generic human taste review is optional under AD42, and this read creates no new approval or delivery gate.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B332: existing consumers and current direction
folds.body:
All 91 original lines were reviewed, including F7–F9 source slices, the involvement table, capability combinations, observation/discovery distinctions, personal goals, UI proposals and T1–T4 research limits. Keep the useful evidence boundaries: Stardew watering and bait consumers are selected source observations; the Immortal Life tables and empty declarations do not prove executed simulation. No retained payload, donor UI, PDF, game installation or native behavior was inspected anew in this reconciliation.

P6–P10 remain a palette consistent with later AD52: routine completion can yield real discoveries, optional detail does not reroll committed results, and a fitting strong power may eliminate a chore. Watching, performing, directing, teaching and receiving a worker report need their actual learning paths. A correlation, a stable variety, a treatment response and heritable change remain separate claims. A routine need not interrupt for every ordinary result, but retaining an anomaly for inspection needs actual custody and knowledge rather than revealing a helper's private understanding.

Whole-life fishing, a small garden, teaching, collections and community continuity remain viable goals without an estate or business as the compulsory endpoint. The phrase about intended outcomes does not guarantee every goal under any chosen attention level, calendar, unsupported means or harsh world law. Actual resources, time, access and capability still determine feasibility. Distributional variation is compatible with repeatable laws; reopening a view should not replace an already committed physical result.

Later desktop direction qualifies the old 1366×768 Proto23 scope; it is historical evidence, not the present universal viewport gate. Shared navigation and useful local detail remain valuable, but no pond/grid diagram or new shell is required where spatial distinctions do not matter. The old separate human-acceptance wording is optional generic review under AD42. T3's absent bulk directory and the old unavailable loader are dated observations, not current installation facts. No new decompile or source expansion was authorized by the research recommendations. Preserve all proposals and history; none was implemented or promoted to accepted direction here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B332: existing consumers and current direction
folds.body:
All 104 original lines were reviewed: authority, EG1–EG8, TF1–TF3, five complete EP packets and the final sequencing recommendation. Preserve EG3 as a specific historical source discrepancy between Riverbank's award flag and the display's cycle wording. It needs the actual current producer/award/presentation and intended timing before a behavioral fix or comparison; do not normalize every fishing spot's balance from a report alone. The present read did not inspect runtime source or reproduce XP behavior.

The other bounded findings remain useful: Farming wages and MG06 crop commands are not automatically joined; authored growth notes are not causal experiments; a pole/skill/drop loop is not bait consumption; a named power needs a real action consumer; a foreman command and finite repetition program do not establish general delegation or closed-app growth. Source hashes and line snapshots preserve the original slice, not current completeness. The Taiwu max/sum/average rules are task-dependent examples, and an Offline method name does not establish app-closed simulation. The herb-crafting UI is not a farm screenshot.

Retain EP1–EP5 as individually selectable refinements through existing activity, skill, knowledge, stock, job and shared UI owners. Later AD51/AD52 support one useful consumer and compression without a universal manual-first prerequisite, yield multiplier, new skill taxonomy, ecology penalty or independent farm-magic engine. Personal participation can express a real technique and affect outcomes without a blanket click bonus. A delegated result keeps the actual producer and recipient; the player may still learn through a separately supported observation, planning or teaching path. Loss of a helper or access changes the actual supported work rather than retroactively erasing settled output.

The one-plot crop and multi-species gather-cycle observations constrain the cited revision, not every future world. A new single-catch intervention needs an explicit compatibility choice if the current chosen consumer still rolls several outputs. Do not draw a multi-bed field or expose exact hidden catch chances just because the donor has them. The old 1366×768 target and human feel gate are historical; use current desktop direction and AD42 for a later selected UI slice. EP ordering is expressly a recommendation, not a new mandatory dependency chain. No source, runtime, save, reward, viewport behavior or current donor state was verified or changed here.
